seed.description: a 64- or 32-bit integer used as the value of the key.
constraints: If seed is not provided, a default value will be used.

impl.description: optional string specifying the PRNG implementation (e.g. ``'threefry2x32'``)
constraints: impl must be string type if provided.

output.description: A scalar PRNG key array, consumable by random functions as well as ``split`` and ``fold_in``.
